description: Everything takes time , sitting in this moment is preparation #selfsufficient #selflove #letgo
transcript: Everything takes time and your time will come. But you don't get to decide if that is seconds, minutes, years, decades. The more that I allow time to reveal itself to me, it keeps me in the state of sitting in this present moment, also sitting in a state of preparation. Preparation for me looks like living fully in this moment. It looks like taking a reset when it's necessary. It looks like pulling back when necessary. It looks like giving myself the most full experience. And that looks like being a steward of my life and fully investing in where I am today in order to open doors for tomorrow.
